title: Project-reported roadside-cuttings collection and process-chain observations from Greenhub Zuid-Holland dry-runs
license: No explicit dataset or article reuse license identified; citations and factual transcription only. Redistribution rights are not inferred.
geography: Greenhub Zuid-Holland operational dry-run; South Holland, Netherlands

source_locations.SRC-GHZH-DRYRUN-2024: Article dated 2024-10-23; paragraphs on summer collection, contractors, cut/rest rules, safety strip, weather, aggregate collected quantity, and chopping incident.
source_locations.SRC-GHZH-PROCESS-2024: Article dated 2024-11-11; paragraphs on ensiling, screening, pressing, fibre and grass-juice routes, flocculation, and partner digestate.
source_locations.SRC-GHZH-DRYRUN-2025-AMBIGUOUS: Article dated 2025-11-28; section titled 'De praktijk: de korte keten van 2026', listing destinations and quantities, contractor counts, and a three-day collection window. The publication date and campaign heading conflict.
source_locations.SRC-GHZH-RESULTS-UNDATED: Current project results page, section 'Resultaten'; reports 120 tonnes collected with five partners without dates or a stated reporting period.
source_locations.SRC-GHZH-SECONDARY-150T-2025: Duurzaam Gebouwd article dated 2025-06-20, paragraph 2; secondary report says more than 150 t/year was collected over 'the past years', without identifying years or mass basis.
source_locations.SRC-GHZH-AQUAMINERALS-INTENT-2026: Greenhub Zuid-Holland announcement dated 2026-09-23; 'Samen leren en ontwikkelen', paragraph 2, describes a planned mapping of grass availability and quality; no results are reported.

evidence_class: First-party project-reported observations and plans plus one secondary industry/trade-press collection claim; no underlying weighbridge or lab dataset is supplied

units_and_basis.t: Source-reported tonnes; fresh/dry basis and weighing protocol are not stated unless specified in the row.
units_and_basis.days: Source-reported contract or operational planning interval; not a fitted kinetic parameter.
units_and_basis.t/year: Secondary article's lower-bound annual collection claim; exact years and wet/dry basis are not stated.
units_and_basis.qualitative: Descriptive project scope/plan; not a measured parameter.
units_and_basis.cm: Source-reported cut length limit in one contractor incident.
units_and_basis.contractors: Count as stated by project article; not a supply capacity.

data_handling: Factual observations transcribed from first-party project pages/articles and one secondary trade article. The >150 t/year claim is stored as a threshold lower bound, not a point estimate. The AquaMinerals item records a planned data inventory with no reported results. Ambiguous, unreported, and qualitative fields remain blank or explicitly labeled; no quantities were summed, converted, reconciled, or activated as model parameters.
limitations: This is a first-party narrative summary, not access to weigh tickets, contractor logs, laboratory certificates, or process mass balances.
The 2024 aggregate 117 t has no stated wet/dry basis, geographic source split, exact campaign date, contractor split, moisture, composition, or uncertainty.

The project results page separately reports 120 t collected with five partners but gives no reporting period, measurement basis, site split, or weighing protocol; it must not be annualized, added to, or treated as confirmation of the separate 117 t dry-run figure.

A 2025 secondary trade article says more than 150 t/year was collected over 'the past years'; it names no exact years, weighing records, wet/dry basis, or collection scope. This is not a measurement series and must not be reconciled with the 117 t campaign or undated 120 t statement.

The current project page reports 100 t Bokashi used at a tree nursery but supplies no time basis, feedstock fraction, moisture basis, recipe, nutrient assay, or process yield. It is not evidence of digestate-derived fertilizer recovery.
The 2026 AquaMinerals announcement describes a planned availability/quality mapping; no results or underlying dataset are linked from the announcement.

The November 2025 article has a temporal inconsistency: it is published in 2025 but labels a section as the short-chain dry-run of 2026. Its campaign-specific quantities are retained with the discrepancy and must not be used in year-specific supply calculations.
The 600 t Bokashi amount is explicitly described as GKB's own grass and is not identified as roadside material; it is excluded from roadside-feed availability.
Qualitative chain descriptions do not provide recoveries, energy, reagent demand, emissions, costs, product grades, or validated mass/energy balances.
The articles relate to Greenhub Zuid-Holland, not directly to the East Netherlands project supply area; these are operational analogues and not default feedstock data.
No DOI or explicit reuse license was found for these web sources.
